name: Valverde — notte con vento forte
description: Stesso territorio di Valverde, ma l'incendio parte di notte dal bordo ovest del bosco, con vento forte da ovest e vegetazione molto secca. Meno ore di luce, allerta più tardiva.

msel.title: Night call: flames on the west edge of the forest
msel.text: 02:30 – A night driver reports flames on the west edge of the North Forest, about 700 m west of Pineta. Strong wind from the west at 55 km/h, very dry vegetation. Visibility is poor and the glow is visible from the village.
msel.objective: Initial situational awareness at night; limited information

msel.title: Residents asleep
msel.text: The caretaker of the Pineta Primary School sees the glow from his flat. The school is empty, but several families nearby are asleep and no one has been warned.
msel.objective: Warning a sleeping population; choosing between warning and evacuation

msel.title: Wind stronger than forecast
msel.text: The wind is now gusting to 70 km/h from the west. Embers are expected to carry well ahead of the front.
